title: State tribunal and support enforcement agency.
bodyText:
(a) The family court, the child support enforcement agency established by section 576D-2, and the office of child support hearings are the tribunals of this State.

(b) The child support enforcement agency is the support enforcement agency of this State.
bodyHtml:
§576B-103  State tribunal and support enforcement agency.  (a)  The family court, the child support enforcement agency established by section 576D-2, and the office of child support hearings are the tribunals of this State.

     (b)  The child support enforcement agency is the support enforcement agency of this State. [L 1997, c 295, pt of §1; §576B-102; ren and am L 2015, c 77, pt of §1]
